reviews.text:
The entire staff is very competent.
Dr. Bianchi is wonderful.
I wouldn't change this veterinary center for anything in the world.

Dr. Bianchi was fantastic with my cat for the extraction of a broken canine tooth, but she was also fantastic with me, who was very worried and anxious! Immediately after the operation, the cat was already doing great, it almost seemed like she was thanking me 😂 🥰 …

Unfortunately, I've had to visit many veterinary clinics, but this was the worst.
Dr. Bianchi insisted on operating on my puppy immediately (in the end, the other two specialists advised against it, and they were right because everything resolved itself spontaneously). She also blamed me for neglecting the puppy, saying he would never be able to grasp his mouth again. Luckily, she was completely wrong. I hope you don't bring any puppies. Furthermore, another doctor showed little empathy, making her debut in public in the waiting room in front of everyone, almost giggling, "Ah, but there's not much you can do!"
Tell me before you do a checkup, what kind of professionalism is this?
From the first to the last, all fantastic from every point of view, thank you ❤️ Alice and Emma

A fabulous team! They lovingly cared for Bruno, Marisa, and since 2019, Diego (all boxers). Always available, professionally trained, and above all, they rely on other excellent specialists. Over the years, they have always addressed the pathologies of these velvet faces, advising on the right strategy for every problem encountered. Thank you all! The adventure continues with you! 🐾💓👩🏼‍⚕️👩🏽‍⚕️👩‍⚕️👩🏻‍⚕️👩‍⚕️💯
Dr. Bianchi has great professionalism and love for animals.

After many rounds and fruitless treatments, I went to Dr. Bianchi on June 14th for a consultation about the dental situation of my 15-year-old dog, Argo. Thanks to her professionalism, she deemed the dental problem, serious as it may be, less urgent than an in-depth internal medicine assessment. Which I did on Saturday, June 15th in Perugia. She was right, alas! Now we're on palliative care. I can't thank her enough for her human and professional honesty. Edoardo
